name: Hajime
source:
"Don't bother me, okay?"

Type: Humanoid Dragon
A one-eyed dragon king.
He controls climate (wind).

Favorites: sake

The most mysterious man among the four who appeared in front of you when mononokes attacked the castle.
Hajime always smirks and dodges questions. But he sometimes shows his emotion, which attracts you a lot.
He hides his feelings behind a smile. What happened to him in the past?

[From in-game profile]
